enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Brush teeth. Wash face. Take shower. Dry with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, eggs, milk and close refrigerator. Toast bread. Crack eggs into bowl. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil and eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off cooker. Slide eggs onto plate. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into cup, add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink tea. Stand, carry plate and cup to sink, rinse, and load dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag and laptop
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Open work bag. Place computer in bag. Place phone in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Take phone out, unlock, open music app. Put on headphones. Press play. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Bus approaches stop. Press stop button. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter office building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email and read messages. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Call partner organization. Discuss program details. Hang up. Open calendar and check schedule. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting and take notes. Discuss with colleagues. Walk back to desk. Open program materials. Review and edit documents. Print materials. Walk to printer and pick up printouts. Call volunteer and follow up. Type report and save file.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of office. Walk to nearby restaurant. Enter restaurant. Walk to counter. Look at menu. Order food. Pay for food. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk out of restaurant. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, preparing program materials and following up with volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open program materials. Edit documents. Print materials. Walk to printer. Pick up printouts. Walk back to desk. Sort materials. Pick up phone. Call volunteer. Follow up on tasks. Hang up. Send email to volunteers. Update database. Organize files. Prepare presentation. Review schedule. Turn off computer.

Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Take phone out. Check messages. Listen to music. Bus approaches stop. Press stop button. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to house. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat, etc. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cabinet. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add ingredients to pan. Stir ingredients. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Slide food onto plate.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate. Carry plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plate. Scrape food into trash. Place plate in sink. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Repeat for other dishes. Pick up towel. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Rinse sponge. Put away dish soap. Hang towel. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. TV turns on. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer under the desk lamp for personal admin and next-day planning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open calendar. Check next day's schedule. Open email. Reply to personal emails. Open banking app. Pay bills. Open notes app. Write to-do list. Review tasks. Close applications. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Put on pajamas. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.
Lie down on bed. Pull covers. Close eyes. Sleep.
